	add_to_global_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_all target = building_type:nd_yua_mamba_datsan }
}

# Copied from CM's cm_ab_stage_custom_roster by buildings.py, over the National Destinies list's lists.
cm_perf_nd_stage_list = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = cm_perf_nd_types_list }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = cm_perf_nd_types_list
			save_scope_as = cm_building_type
			scope:cm_country = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_types_enabled target = scope:cm_building_type } }
					if = {
						limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_types_in_subjects_enabled target = scope:cm_building_type } }
						set_local_variable = { name = cm_ab_custom_subjects value = 1 }
					} else = {
						set_local_variable = { name = cm_ab_custom_subjects value = 0 }
					}
					cm_ab_resolve_building_type = yes
					cm_ab_stage_roster_type_owned = yes
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:cm_ab_custom_subjects = 1 }
						cm_ab_stage_roster_type_in_subjects = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Copied from CM's cm_ab_drain_custom_roster by buildings.py, over the National Destinies list's lists.
cm_perf_nd_drain_list = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = cm_perf_nd_types_list }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = cm_perf_nd_types_list
			save_scope_as = cm_building_type
			scope:cm_country = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_types_enabled target = scope:cm_building_type } }
					cm_ab_resolve_building_type = yes
					# The raw key, not the resolved one: the resolve walks marketplace up to its
					# current tier, which no longer matches building_type:marketplace.
					if = {
						limit = { scope:cm_ab_settings_type = building_type:marketplace }
						cm_ab_drain_custom_by_market_access = yes
					} else = {
						cm_ab_drain_custom_resolved = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# The list. Rows stand for nothing until cm_perf_nd_assign_rows gives them a building; the
# placeholder keeps CMF's per-row walk from carrying the previous row's building into one that
# has none. Registration runs on every load, so a row's building is set only once. Root is the
# country.
cm_perf_nd_register = {
	cmm_register_settings_list = {

# Gives each of this country's buildings a row the first time the country qualifies for it (the
# potential of the advance that unlocks it), in National Destinies' own order, and never takes
# it back: a tag change only adds rows. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_assign_rows = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_perf_nd_rows_used } } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows_used value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = ADU }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_madrasa }

		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_forge }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_suq }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_diwan }

# Root is the country. $bt$ = the building type. Kept small: it is pasted once per building.
cm_perf_nd_assign = {
	building_type:$bt$ = { save_scope_as = cm_perf_nd_t }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows target = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
			var:cm_perf_nd_rows_used < 40
		}
		cm_perf_nd_place_row = yes
	}
}

# The next free row gets scope:cm_perf_nd_t. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_place_row = {
	change_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows_used add = 1 }
	add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows target = scope:cm_perf_nd_t }
	set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_new value = 1 }
	switch = {
		trigger = var:cm_perf_nd_rows_used
		1 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 1 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		2 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 2 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		3 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 3 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		4 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 4 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		5 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 5 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		6 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 6 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		7 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 7 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		8 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 8 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		9 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 9 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		10 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 10 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		11 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 11 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		12 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 12 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		13 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 13 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		14 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 14 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		15 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 15 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		16 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 16 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		17 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 17 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		18 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 18 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		19 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 19 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		20 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 20 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		21 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 21 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		22 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 22 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		23 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 23 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }

		27 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 27 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }

		31 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 31 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
		32 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 32 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }

# New rows first, then each row shown while its building can be built (or a later tier of it
# can), as CM shows its own roster. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_refresh_rows = {
	cm_perf_nd_assign_rows = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_cm__auto_build_nd }
		cmm_for_each_list_item = { setting = cm__auto_build_nd effect = cm_perf_nd_row_visibility }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_local_variable = cm_perf_nd_new }
		cm_rebuild_auto_build_lookups = yes
	}
	cm_perf_ndi_refresh_rows = yes
}

# Callback for cmm_for_each_list_item. A row's label reads its building from
# var:cm_perf_nd_bt_<row> (localization cm__auto_build_nd_i<row>_name): set here rather
# than once, so a save whose rows predate it gets its names too. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_row_visibility = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value } }
		set_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_bt_$i$ value = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value }
		# +perf20 tried to relabel the row by copying a flag between variables; put the row's
		# label back on its own key, as CMF's _cmm_initialize_list_item_metadata sets it.
		set_variable = { name = $setting$_i$i$_name value = flag:$setting$_i$i$_name }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					can_build_building = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value
					building_type_is_obsolete = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value
				}
			}
			cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = $i$ }
		}
		else = {
			cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = $i$ }
		}
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = $i$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = no }
		cmf_suppress = { v = $setting$_$i$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = no exists = var:cm_perf_nd_bt_$i$ }
	}
}

# The list's own lists, rebuilt with the roster's lookups (cm_rebuild_auto_build_lookups), and
# its rows' thresholds into the roster's maps, which are keyed by building type. Root is the
# country.
cm_perf_nd_merge = {
	clear_variable_list = cm_perf_nd_types_list
	clear_variable_list = cm_perf_nd_types_enabled
	clear_variable_list = cm_perf_nd_types_in_subjects_enabled
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_cm__auto_build_nd }
		cmm_for_each_list_item = { setting = cm__auto_build_nd effect = cm_perf_nd_merge_row }
	}
}

# Callback for cmm_for_each_list_item. Fields in registration order: 1 enabled, 2 in_subjects,
# 3 min_control, 4 min_discount. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_merge_row = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_types_list target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value }
		# Read as CMF's own _cmm_build_list_*_item read them: every field has its default from
		# registration on, so the cmm map holds each key.
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fk value = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f1 }
		if = {
			limit = { "variable_map(cmm|local_var:cm_perf_nd_fk)" >= 1 }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_types_enabled target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fk value = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f2 }
		if = {
			limit = { "variable_map(cmm|local_var:cm_perf_nd_fk)" >= 1 }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_types_in_subjects_enabled target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fk value = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fv value = "variable_map(cmm|local_var:cm_perf_nd_fk)" }
		change_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fv multiply = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = cm_min_control_by_building_type key = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value value = local_var:cm_perf_nd_fv }
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fk value = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fv value = "variable_map(cmm|local_var:cm_perf_nd_fk)" }
		change_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fv multiply = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = cm_min_discount_by_building_type key = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value value = local_var:cm_perf_nd_fv }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = no }
		cmf_suppress = { v = $setting$_$i$ }
	}
}

# Root is the country. $bt$ = the building type.
cm_perf_ndi_assign = {
	building_type:$bt$ = { save_scope_as = cm_perf_ndi_t }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_ndi_rows target = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
			var:cm_perf_ndi_rows_used < 40
		}
		cm_perf_ndi_place_row = yes
	}
}

# The next free row gets scope:cm_perf_ndi_t. Root is the country.
cm_perf_ndi_place_row = {
	change_variable = { name = cm_perf_ndi_rows_used add = 1 }
	add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_ndi_rows target = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t }
	switch = {
		trigger = var:cm_perf_ndi_rows_used
		1 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 1 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		2 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 2 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		3 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 3 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		4 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 4 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		5 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 5 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		6 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 6 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		7 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 7 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		8 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 8 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		9 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 9 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		10 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 10 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		11 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 11 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		12 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 12 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		13 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 13 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		14 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 14 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		15 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 15 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		16 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 16 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		17 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 17 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		18 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 18 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		19 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 19 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		20 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 20 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		21 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 21 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		22 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 22 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		23 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 23 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		24 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 24 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		25 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 25 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		26 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 26 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		27 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 27 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		28 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 28 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }

		32 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 32 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		33 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 33 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		34 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 34 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }
		35 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 35 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }

		37 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = 37 value = scope:cm_perf_ndi_t } }

	}
}

# Rows with a building are shown, open or not; the rest hidden. Root is the country.
cm_perf_ndi_refresh_rows = {
	cm_perf_ndi_assign_rows = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_cm__auto_build_nd_info }
		cmm_for_each_list_item = { setting = cm__auto_build_nd_info effect = cm_perf_ndi_row_visibility }
	}
}

# Callback for cmm_for_each_list_item; labels as cm_perf_nd_row_visibility. Root is the country.
cm_perf_ndi_row_visibility = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_ndi_rows target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value } }
		set_variable = { name = cm_perf_ndi_bt_$i$ value = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					can_build_building = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value
					building_type_is_obsolete = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = cm_perf_ndi_open_$i$ value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = cm_perf_ndi_open_$i$ value = 0 }
		}
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = $i$ }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd_info item = $i$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = no }
		cmf_suppress = { v = $setting$_$i$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = no
			exists = var:cm_perf_ndi_bt_$i$
			exists = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f1
			exists = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f2
			exists = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f3
			exists = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f4
			exists = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f5
		}
	}
}
